UX Case Study · 2024

The Bluegrass
Situation

Transforming a static music platform into a structured, content-driven experience focused on artist discovery and storytelling.

My Role
Platform
Focus
Project Scope
The Bluegrass Situation is a music-focused editorial platform. The objective was to redesign the existing single-page website into a scalable, content-rich experience that supports artist storytelling, media integration, and structured navigation.
My Role
UX Designer
  • Redesigned the complete website experience
  • Defined content structure and layout hierarchy
  • Worked within client-provided visual guidelines
  • Focused on usability, hierarchy, and engagement
Problem Statement

The existing website was a minimal single-page layout that lacked the structure needed to support growing content. Users were unable to easily explore artists, discover new content, or navigate between sections effectively due to the absence of hierarchy and dedicated content areas.

User Research

Understanding the Users

To understand how users explore music platforms, I analyzed similar content-driven websites and observed common interaction patterns. The focus was on how users discover artists, consume media, and navigate between different types of content.

Pain Points
  • Lack of content hierarchy
  • No dedicated space for artists
  • Difficult to explore or discover new content
  • Limited engagement due to static layout
Goals
  • Create a structured, multi-section experience
  • Improve content discoverability
  • Introduce artist-focused sections
  • Enable media-rich engagement (YouTube & Spotify)
Design Showcase

Designs

01 — Homepage

Homepage

Designed a structured homepage that introduces clear content sections and improves overall navigation and discoverability.

02 — Artist Section

Artist Section

Created dedicated artist-focused sections to highlight featured musicians, interviews, playlists, and latest releases. This improves artist discoverability and audience engagement.

03 — Editorial Content System

Editorial Content System

Created modular layouts for interviews, articles, features, and long-form storytelling with better readability and hierarchy.

04 — Playlists & Media Experience

Playlists & Media Experience

Integrated playlists, podcasts, videos, and multimedia sections into a scalable and engaging content ecosystem.
